## Rubrik Announces Protection for Microsoft Azure Cosmos DB


November 18, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/667520861/files/doc_news/Rubrik-Announces-Protection-for-Microsoft-Azure-Cosmos-DB-2026.pdf)


*Expanded cyber recovery and resilience capabilities secure the data layer behind enterprise AI applications*


SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


**MICROSOFT IGNITE** – Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, today announced protection for Microsoft Azure Cosmos DB, a fully managed NoSQL and vector database for modern app development.


The expanded Rubrik Cloud Data Protection capabilities protect the data layer behind enterprise AI applications with immutable, application-consistent protection built for scale. Rubrik provides an independent, air-gapped copy of the systems on Azure, to keep critical data recoverable and resilient during operational disruptions or cyberattacks.


"Azure Cosmos DB is where AI applications keep the data they depend on: the vectors, the memory, the state," said Anneka Gupta, Chief Product Officer at Rubrik. "Availability keeps that data online, but it doesn't bring the business back after a disruption, whether that’s an operational failure or an attack. By extending Rubrik Cloud Data Protection to Cosmos DB, Azure teams will be able to recover at the level they need, at scale, from an air-gapped immutable copy in a separate trust domain, so the data behind their enterprise AI applications stays recoverable even if production identities are compromised.”


As organizations rapidly scale AI workloads, Azure Cosmos DB has become the data layer behind mission-critical applications.[Microsoft reported](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.microsoft.com%2Fen-us%2Finvestor%2Fevents%2Ffy-2026%2Fearnings-fy-2026-q3&esheet=54642000&newsitemid=20261118739339&lan=en-US&anchor=Microsoft+reported&index=1&md5=e32391d3b502eb6208b33c1f3d023a01) in April 2026 that Azure Cosmos DB revenue was up 50% year over year, driven by AI application workloads. When that layer is deleted, corrupted, or encrypted, the application stops behaving correctly, not just the data.


"Customers are building their most important AI applications on Azure Cosmos DB,” said Kirill Gavrylyuk, vice president, Cosmos DB at Microsoft. “Working with Rubrik gives them another way to help protect and recover the data for their applications, as part of a resilient cloud strategy."


**Resilient Recovery Across Cloud Boundaries**


Financial services, healthcare, and retail organizations require a recovery strategy built for both operational continuity and cyber resilience. Rubrik brings Azure Cosmos DB into the same unified policy engine used for the rest of their cloud applications.


- **Protection at Scale:** Provides daily immutable backups for Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL databases up to 10 TB within a 24-hour window, so even the largest data layers stay protected without competing with production application traffic.
- **Precision Restores:** Enables self-service recovery at the container level to existing or new accounts, with partition keys, indexing policies and consistency settings preserved. Rubrik allows recoveries across different subscriptions, regions, and tenants.
- **Application-Consistent Recovery:** Captures every change, including deletions, so recovery reflects the exact committed state of the application and gives regulated customers a reliable audit trail.
- **Independent Isolation:** Rubrik protects against compromised production credentials by securing data in an independent trust domain outside the native Azure identity boundary.
- **Extended Retention and Compliance:** Organizations can enforce SLA-driven retention policies to store data for months or years, which surpasses the native thirty-five day limit to meet the requirements for strict regulatory compliance.


Rubrik’s protection for Microsoft Azure Cosmos DB is expected to be generally available in the coming months. For more information, visit Rubrik booth #1159 at Microsoft Ignite or explore the[Azure Cloud-Native Data Protection](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rubrik.com%2Fsolutions%2Fazure-native-protection&esheet=54642000&newsitemid=20261118739339&lan=en-US&anchor=Azure+Cloud-Native+Data+Protection&index=2&md5=94da49c31af88d2c48a904c1fd690c9f) page.
